scope: Independent source and local evidence review only. Reviewer did not build the proposal, perform browser QA, or make external writes.
approved_scope: Source review passes for staging only the three bound proposed files on existing unpublished theme 137888792673, subject to root's fresh source/target guard and exact before-state inverse. Actual updated-draft buyer verification remains pending. No MAIN or publication action is approved by this review.
summary: Frozen V7 retains all three demonstrated or source-replayed selector failures. The three-file local proposal uses the existing native picker for all E1/E2 variants without assigning new roles or converting height labels. It preserves explicit Trail Plaid Girl/Boy roles and removes all 16 selection-key collisions. Both sticky routing changes are consistent with actual initialization order. No blocking source defect was found. The initial test teardown issue was corrected; the reviewer independently reran all 11 tests successfully with no runtime errors. Actual affected buyer-flow verification remains required.

authority_and_preservation.note: Compared local files with saved private source evidence; reviewer performed no fresh API query. API byte sizes were compared numerically because the saved size fields are strings.

product_evidence.currency_conclusion: The role classifier and selection keys do not use currency or contextual price. The same exact IDs/options/SKUs produce the same failure in US and AU source replay; this is not independent rendered US/AU buyer proof.

findings.cause: Opaque numeric SKUs supply no role. The standalone-size regex excludes cm values and qualified adult labels such as S (Adult Normal Version) and S (Adult Extended Version). Role parsing recognizes aliases at the start or end, not inside those parentheses. Null-role variants are dropped, leaving no builder groups.
findings.proposal: Whole-product native fallback. All original raw Size/Color values and variant IDs remain available to the existing Dawn form; no role or height-to-age inference is added.

findings.cause: Six 100cm–150cm variants fail the same classifier while S/M/L remain in an adult group. An empty-groups-only fallback would leave the six height variants unreachable.
findings.proposal: The any-unclassified-variant preflight correctly selects whole-product native fallback, including the already recognized S/M/L variants.

findings.cause: Garment-derived Shirt/Shorts inference changes explicit or SKU-backed Girl to Boy. Girl and Boy then share role, age size and Type; the resolver returns the first matching option. Example: Girl 44080556343393 and Boy 44080556605537 share Boy / 1-2 Years / Shirt in V7.
findings.proposal: Garment inference refines only generic adult/child roles. Explicit Girl/Boy/Mother/Father remain distinct; the exact 56 variants have no duplicate selection identities.

findings.cause: V7 hides native Add and option controls via the matching-set class. Its empty builder branch only hides the builder. The inline mobile sticky executes during parsing and captures bundle mode before deferred DOMContentLoaded initialization; desktop mode originally used builder presence alone.
findings.proposal: Fallback runs before the legacy guide-hide write, removes matching CSS/data flags, and dispatches a section-scoped event. Mobile resets captured bundle mode, CTA and both observers; desktop initializes afterward using the fallback marker. Added CSS keeps the existing desktop-UX/review wrapper displayed.

independent_checks_actually_run: Evaluated complete actual MAIN, V7 and proposed JS in jsdom, then invoked their role functions using all 79 target variants with exact captured options and SKUs. MAIN/V7 produced E1 14 nulls, E2 6 nulls, Trail 16 collisions; proposal chose E1/E2 native fallback and removed Trail collisions.
Evaluated full V7/proposed JS on all 279 variants of the six ordinary-buyer holdout products. Exact role outputs remained equal and none activated fallback.
Matched all 79 target variant ID/options sequences across SKU binding, AU snapshot and fresh US snapshot; availability also matched.
Verified every proposed manifest hash and byte length against disk, all three baseline hashes, and targeted MAIN/V7 MD5 bindings.
Verified all 527 frozen candidate MD5/byte sizes against the saved 20:14:01 private manifest, with zero missing, extra or mismatched files.
Read the exact proposed diffs, the current source around initialization, both sticky handlers, native CSS and preserved guide handling.

Independently ran the corrected focused node --test suite: 11 passed, zero failed, exit 0, no uncaught runtime errors. It compares all 240 source products: only Trail Plaid grouping changes and only E1/E2 trigger native fallback.

parent_test_evidence.finding: Four asynchronous MutationObserver errors occur after jsdom window.close; syncBodyOffset reads a torn-down document. This appears to be test teardown rather than a candidate-browser defect, but the result must not be described as a clean runtime pass.
parent_test_evidence.resolution: VERIFIED: harness retains and disconnects MutationObservers before window.close, captures window errors, and asserts no captured errors. Parent rerun and reviewer independent rerun both passed all 11 tests with no uncaught errors; candidate source did not change for this test correction.
parent_test_evidence.test_scope: Production JS plus extracted inline mobile code, reconstructed DOM and simplified hiding CSS. Checks ordinary routing, disabled native Add, source-control preservation, two widths and bundle-route holdouts; does not render full Liquid or perform real cart writes.

root_theme_check_evidence.checked_copy_basis: All checked theme bytes equal the three bound proposed files plus the other 524 frozen V7 files.
